Class SceneRouter

java.lang.Object
view.SceneRouter
public class SceneRouter extends Object
Single navigation hub for the whole GUI. Each screen calls back into the router to move forward (or backward), the ClientStateListenerGui uses it to address the ViewController that is on screen and to overlay toasts on top of the current root. It's created by the ClientMain and passed to each controller. Handles the followings:
  • Move from one ViewController to another and loads its FXML
  • Handles commands and errors for joining the server between the NickViewController and the ClientMain

    • toWinner

      public void toWinner(List<PlayerDto> players, List<String> winners)
      Navigates to the winner view, showing the point info of the game. Called when the game terminates early due to disconnection of player, there are no EndGameScoringDto to show.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of players DTO in the game
      winners - the list of the winners of the games, could be one or more than one if it's a draw

    • toWinner

      public void toWinner(List<PlayerDto> players, List<String> winners, EndGameScoringDto scoring)
      Navigates to the winner view, showing the point info of the game. Called when the game terminates normally, after the 10th round.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of players DTO in the game
      winners - the list of the winners of the games, could be one or more than one if it's a draw
      scoring - DTO reporting the scoring of each player at the end of the game, of each category

    • offerLeaderboard

      public void offerLeaderboard(List<ScoreRecord> lb, int rank, int pts)
      Called by the network listener when DB leaderboard data arrives (async). If the winner screen is already shown, applies the data to it. Otherwise, stores it in pending variables to be applied when the winner screen is shown.
      Parameters:
      lb - the list of all players and their points, sorted by points descending
      rank - the rank of the current player in the leaderboard
      pts - the points of the current player in the leaderboard

    • connect

      public void connect(String transport, String host, int port, NetworkSetupViewController controller)
      Called by the network listener when the connection to the server is lost. Navigates back to the network setup screen and shows a toast with the error message.
      Parameters:
      transport - type of connection: RMI or SOCKET
      host - host ip
      port - server port number
      controller - NetworkSetupViewController used to bind the sceneRouter with the network setup screen, so that the user can try reconnecting

    • connectionEstablished

      public void connectionEstablished()
      Called by the network listener when the connection to the server is successfully established. Asks the sceneRouter to route to the nickname choosing screen.

    • setName

      public void setName(String name, NickViewController controller)
      Called by the nickViewController when the player chooses its name. Asks the clientMain to set the name.
      Parameters:
      name - name chosen by the player
      controller - NickViewController used to bind the sceneRouter with the nickname choosing screen, so that the user can try choosing another nickname if the chosen one is already taken

    • setupSession

      public void setupSession(String name, VirtualServer vs)

      Parameters:
      name - the name of the player accepted by the server
      vs - the reference to the virtual server
